events.name: Drill Sergeant Kangaskhan
events.intro: A Kangaskhan in a whistle and a tiny cap marches your team into a field. "Pick a stat! Everything else, EYES FRONT!" Her baby salutes from the pouch.

success.text: The sergeant barks, you sweat, and it works. Strength drills drills leave your Pokémon sharper, and sorer.
The sergeant barks, you sweat, and it works. Guard drills drills leave your Pokémon sharper, and sorer.
The sergeant barks, you sweat, and it works. Footwork drills drills leave your Pokémon sharper, and sorer.
She salutes back. "Smart recruits know when to rest!"

events.name: Weight Room Roulette
events.intro: A basement gym with a spinning rack of plates. "Pick your weight and spin the wheel," the owner grins. "Heavier gets you bigger. Usually."

success.text: Easy reps. Nobody is hurt and you feel a little stronger.
Solid set. Your lead hits a new rep record.

failure.text: The bar slips. A bruised pride and a bruised paw.

success.text: The whole gym cheers. A huge lift builds real power.

failure.text: The bar drops on your lead's foot. Ouch.

success.text: You pass. The owner looks hurt.

events.name: Speed Lane Treadmill
events.intro: A glass-walled treadmill lane with a countdown clock. "Beat the clock and keep your pace," says the attendant. The belt is already humming.

success.text: You hit the beat and the belt screams. Personal best!

failure.text: You miss the beat and stumble off the belt. Still, some pace gained.

success.text: A relaxed pace. Good for the lungs.
The clock ticks on without you.

events.name: Mentor Montage
events.intro: A grizzled veteran waves you over. "Three drills. Don't blink, it's a montage." A drum beat starts from nowhere.

success.text: Dodging logs in a river. Your team learns to read the water.
"No montage, no glory," the veteran mutters.

events.name: Mentor Montage: Step 2
events.intro: Step two: punch a hanging sack in time to the drum. The veteran nods slowly.

success.text: Every hit lands on the beat.
Slow, clean, precise.

events.name: Mentor Montage: Finale
events.intro: Step three: a sunset run up the final hill. The veteran waits at the top with a thermos and a small proud smile.

success.text: Cheers from nowhere. The lead gains real experience, and the veteran admits you've got it.

effects.text: A veteran put the team through a three-step training montage.

success.text: A slow climb together. Nobody is left behind.

events.name: Egg Moves Library
events.intro: A cosy library of hatching scrolls. "Rare techniques only the youngest Pokémon know," the librarian whispers. "Three hundred for a lesson."

success.text: The librarian opens a scroll. Your lead learns a rare move.
You read a while. Mostly dust and good advice.

events.name: Sprint Intervals
events.intro: A coach with a stopwatch lines your team up. "Intervals! Go fast now, pay later."

success.text: Your team flies. Defense will suffer for the next 3 fights, but nothing is faster.
A light jog. Good for the legs.

events.name: Veteran's Notebook
events.intro: A battered notebook sits on a bench, margins full of arrows and "WEAK TO SURF!!" underlined twice. A name is scrawled inside: a gym leader's.

success.text: The old veteran's notes lay out the gym leader's whole team.
Messy notes on how bosses telegraph their big moves. You steal a few tricks.
You leave it where it was. Someone will be glad.

events.name: Battle Replay Theater
events.intro: A tiny cinema plays slow-motion clips of fights like yours. "Free for trainers," says the usher. "Learn from your mistakes."

success.text: You catch every mistake. Your lead picks up a trickle of experience.

choices.label: Take notes with the whole team

success.text: Everyone watches together. Slower, but everyone learns.
You head out. Popcorn is overpriced anyway.

events.name: Tactical Chalkboard
events.intro: A chalkboard outside a clubhouse, covered in X's and O's. "Analyse the next fight," says the coach. "Know the enemy's lead."

success.text: Chalk arrows point at each trainer's team ahead of you. You will see what's coming.
Notes on the local wildlife. The map suggests what waits in the grass.
Some lessons have to be learned the hard way.

events.name: Swim Class
events.intro: A lifeguard whistles from a pool deck. "Free swim class! Water types train best, everybody else floats."

success.text: Strokes, dives and a buoyancy game. Water Pokémon beam.
Everyone floats happily. Nobody trains much, nobody sinks.
The lifeguard shrugs. Pools are for people who like pools.

events.name: Obstacle Dojo
events.intro: A dojo full of swinging bags, narrow beams and spinning poles. "Pass the whole course without a scratch," the master says, "and the Focus Sash is yours."

success.text: Not a scratch! The master hands over a Focus Sash.

failure.text: A swinging bag clips your lead. Better luck next time.

success.text: Slow and safe. No sash, but you learn the course.
The master bows. The course waits.

events.name: Trainer's Pep Talk
events.intro: A cheerful trainer in a tracksuit waves a clipboard. "You've got this! Hands in, everybody!"

success.text: A huddle and a loud cheer. Your team's Attack is raised for the next fight.
One-on-one reassurance. The lead feels invincible.
They give a thumbs up and jog on.

events.name: Team Photo Day
events.intro: A photographer sets up a backdrop in the square. "Team photo! Everybody squeeze in! Say Pokéball!"

success.text: Flash! A great shot of the whole team grinning. Unity gets a lasting lift.

effects.text: The team posed for a photo, everyone grinning.

success.text: A funny, blurry photo. Everyone laughs.
You skip it. The photographer sighs.

events.name: Weak Spot Remedy
events.intro: A sports therapist inspects your team with a clipboard. "Everyone has a weak spot. Which one hurts the most?"

success.text: A coach drills your team against fire-type moves until it stings less. A temporary fire resist for 3 fights.
A coach drills your team against water-type moves until it stings less. A temporary water resist for 3 fights.
A coach drills your team against electric-type moves until it stings less. A temporary electric resist for 3 fights.
A coach drills your team against ice-type moves until it stings less. A temporary ice resist for 3 fights.

events.name: Rain Run
events.intro: A summer storm rolls over the training track. A coach in a raincoat grins. "Perfect! Nobody trains in dry weather anyway."

success.text: Puddles, wind and a cheering coach. Water stats rise for the next 3 fights, under a drizzle.
You wait it out and share a snack.

events.name: Sandpit Digging
events.intro: A huge sandpit with a sign: "Dig for TMs!" A sweaty digger leans on a shovel. "Buried a few Ground-type ones. Maybe."

success.text: Your shovel hits something hard. A Ground TM!

failure.text: Just sand and a bent shovel.

success.text: Sand flies. A Ground TM comes out!
The digger returns to the pit.

events.name: Combo Practice
events.intro: Two trainers drill the same two-move combo again and again. "It only works the first time," one says, "so make it count."

success.text: A move chain clicks. Your first attack in the next 3 fights hits harder.
Perfect timing! The combo gets even sharper.

failure.text: Out of sync. Your Pokémon trips over its own feet.

success.text: You watch, take notes and wave goodbye.

events.name: Crowd Support Training
events.intro: A small crowd of fans fills a stand around a training ring. "Defense! Defense!" they chant. "Hold the line!"

success.text: The crowd roars and the team stands tall. Defense rises for the next 2 fights.
You wave. They love it.
You leave quietly.

events.name: Heavy Armor Fitting
events.intro: A blacksmith bangs on a plate of steel. "Heavy armour! Fits Pokémon too. Slows you down, but nothing gets through it."

success.text: A snug plate of steel. Defense up for the rest of the run, but Speed goes down.
Too heavy for your team. The smith nods.
The hammering fades behind you.

events.name: Stretching Break
events.intro: A cheerful instructor leads a stretch break on the grass. "Reach for the sky! Loosen those muscles!"

success.text: Cracks, sighs and a long happy yawn. Status gone, and a little extra speed for the next fight.
A short nap in the sun.
No time for stretching.

events.name: Endurance Hike
events.intro: A trail guide hands out walking sticks. "Six hours up and down! You earn a lot of experience, you lose a lot of breath."

success.text: A long climb. The lead is exhausted and much stronger.
Everyone pitches in. Smaller gains, shared fatigue.
A pleasant stroll. A little fresh air.

events.name: Moveset Rehearsal
events.intro: A coach runs a rehearsal room with mirrors and a scoreboard of moves. "Same Pokémon, new tricks. Pick a lesson and your lead swaps one move for another it can learn."

success.text: Hours of repetition later, the lead has a new move in place of its weakest one.
You stick with what works. The coach nods.

events.name: Cross-Training Camp
events.intro: A camp where Fighting, Psychic and Dark trainers swap drills. "Learn something outside your type," the organiser says.

success.text: Punching and kicking practice. The lead learns a Fighting move.
Spoon-bending and focus work. The lead learns a Psychic move.
Sneaky tricks nobody admits to teaching. The lead learns a Dark move.
You watch and take notes.

events.name: Nature Counselor
events.intro: A soft-spoken counselor sits with a tea set. "Natures are not fixed," she says. "Tell me who your lead wants to be."

success.text: A long chat, a few tears, and a brand new outlook.
The lead rediscovers its fighting spirit.
The lead decides to stop overthinking and move.
"Good. You know them well."

events.name: Ability Capsule Booth
events.intro: A shiny booth with a blinking sign: "ABILITY SWAPS, ₽500!" The attendant holds up a glowing capsule.

success.text: Pop! The capsule fizzes and the lead's ability changes.
Shiny capsules, shinier price tags.

events.name: Hyper Training Gym
events.intro: A gym with a banner: "TURN YOUR WEAKEST STAT INTO A STRENGTH." The trainer cracks their knuckles. "₽400 and we start now."

success.text: Brutal reps on exactly the stat the lead was worst at. It pays off.
The trainer shrugs.

events.name: Mental Training Dojo
events.intro: A quiet dojo with a single candle. "Aim is a state of mind," the sensei says. "Sit, breathe, and see the target before you strike."

success.text: Your team's aim sharpens: moves are more accurate for the next 3 battles.
You hit every mark blindfolded. Aim sharpens a lot.

failure.text: You swing at the candle. It goes out and so does your dignity.

success.text: The sensei bows. The candle burns on.

events.name: TM Workshop
events.intro: A cluttered workshop of soldering irons and half-built discs. "Bring me three Machine Parts and I'll forge you a TM," the engineer says.

success.text: Sparks fly. Out comes a fresh TM.
The engineer shows you a blueprint and sends you off with a tip.

events.name: Evolution Tutor
events.intro: A retired professor with a stack of evolution charts waves you over. "Tell me who you are carrying and I will tell you what they need to change."

success.text: She flips through her charts and reads out the answer.
"Come back when you are curious," she smiles.

events.name: Nap Pod Corner
events.intro: A row of padded nap pods sits beside the road with a sign: "40 minutes can save a day." The lead is already yawning.

success.text: You sleep deeply. The lead feels much better, but you will sleep through the next wild stop.
The pods glow behind you.

events.name: Shadow Boxing
events.intro: A mirrored dojo wall ripples. Your lead's shadow steps out and takes a stance. "Beat yourself," the sensei says.

success.text: Your lead's shadow steps forward, a little weaker than the real thing.

win.text: Your lead beat its own shadow in a mirrored dojo.

success.text: The shadow bows back and fades.

events.name: Mastery Quiz
events.intro: A quiz host with a buzzer waves a clipboard. "Species questions! Get it right and your lead earns a Mastery Shard toward its goals."

success.text: Correct! A Mastery Shard drops into your hand.

failure.text: "Close!" The buzzer sounds, no shard this time.

success.text: Correct! A Mastery Shard for your lead.

failure.text: Wrong. The host consoles you with a snack.

success.text: Your friend knows the answer. A Mastery Shard, but it costs a favour.
The buzzer goes off behind you.

events.name: Graduation Ceremony
events.intro: A small stage with a banner: "GRADUATION". A proud examiner holds two Mastery Shards. "Pass the final assessment and they are yours."

success.text: Top marks! The examiner presents two Mastery Shards and a round of applause.

effects.text: The lead graduated from a species assessment.

failure.text: You come up short. The examiner awards one shard for effort.

success.text: You cheer for someone else's graduate.
